title: Insulin Pump Program Reimbursement Memorandum: Purchased Pumps, Capped Rental and Ownership
content:
**Purchase tiers.** On tiers of the Insulin Pump Program whose pump acquisition method is purchase, the pump is billed once, by an original claim for its E0784 shipment, and the program records the pump as purchased.

**Capped-rental tiers.** On tiers whose pump acquisition method is capped rental, the pump is never billed as a purchase. Larkfield bills one rental claim per rental month — rental months run from the delivery date of the pump, each starting on that same calendar day of the month (the last day of the month when that day does not exist) — numbered 1 upward in the order billed, for each rental month the program is active on its first day. A month in which the program is on hold for its whole length is neither billed nor counted, and a rental month already billed is never billed again.

**The cap.** A rental claim is billed only while the number of rental months already billed on the program — every rental claim of the program over its life through the date of the test, each rental month being billed once — is less than the tier's capped-rental months. After the claim for the last capped rental month is paid, ownership of the pump transfers to the customer, the program records the pump as owned, and no further rental is billed for that pump.

**After ownership and on closure.** Ownership does not change the supplies benefit, which continues under the refill and quantity rules, and a pump owned or purchased by the customer is never taken back when the program closes. When a capped-rental program closes before ownership transfers, rental billing stops with the last month the program was active, and recovery of the rented pump is arranged by Larkfield's equipment team.

## Rental month schedule (hypothetical pump delivered on the 31st of January, 13-month cap)

| Rental month | Starts on |
|---|---|
| 1 | 31 January |
| 2 | the last day of February (no 31st exists) |
| 3 | 31 March |
| 4 | the last day of April (no 31st exists) |

| Rental claims already billed (13-month cap) | Another rental claim |
|---|---|
| 12 | May be billed (month 13) |
| 13 | Not billed; ownership transfers once the month-13 claim is paid |
